citations.assessment: Rav Ashi explicitly addresses Rav Hoshaya the son of Rav Idi on the principle concerning survival for thirty days. The surrounding discussion sets out the doubtful case.
The separate Heilprin notice gives the reversed patronym and names a son, Rabbi Yaakov. This is internal textual evidence. The digital Yevamot occurrence belongs to the form Hoshaya son of Idi.
